objective: Keep reusable Skill procedure separate from persistent Claude Project context.
scenario: A user installs Peanuts as a custom Skill and also creates a Friday Project with knowledge documents and Project instructions. Claude Projects share Project knowledge across chats, but previous chat turns are not automatically a durable record.
expected_behaviors: Skill contains repeatable methods and task procedures.
Project instructions define how the owner uses Friday and the Skill.
Project knowledge stores durable Friday governance, architecture, decisions, and current handoff.
A new chat reads the latest handoff or asks for it rather than assuming it remembers every prior chat.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat chat history as a guaranteed cross-chat source of truth.
Duplicate or diverge the canonical Peanuts methodology into Project instructions.
